## Documented role

[Pamela Fayerman (2018)](../sources/fayerman-2018-walt-lawrence.qmd) reports Lawrence’s account that he lived at George Pearson Hospital and, in 1985, moved with friends into “the Creekview Co-operative Apartment near Granville Island,” and that he later worked as a Vancouver Coastal Health peer counsellor at G.F. Strong.

[SCI BC (2019)](../sources/sci-bc-2019-walt-lawrence.qmd) states that in 1985 he moved into “semi-independent living at the newly constructed **Creekside** development” and that he has worked as a peer counsellor at GF Strong.

The Creekview / Creekside spelling difference is left unresolved.

## Attributed recollection

Fayerman quotes Lawrence on directing care, a CPA cost analysis, and credit to Doug Mowat. Those quotations are attributed recollection in a newspaper interview, not independently verified events.
